name: status-pill
title: Status Pill
summary: A tinted pill with a dot for a status, such as Active or Failed.
description: Tinted pill with a leading status dot: relationship status, run state, health. One line, never wraps or shrinks. Sizes md (24px) and sm (22px); a mark (circle with a check) for a finished state. The squarer, bordered label of tables and fields is the Tag.

anatomy.description: 6px dot in the tone's colour; aria-hidden.

18px circle (16px at sm) with a check, in the tone's colour; replaces the dot for a finished state ("Sent", "Applied"). aria-hidden; it pops in (motion.popup-scale) only when it appears after the pill has been painted.
Text of the status; truncates at the end when the pill has less room than its text. Pass title with the full text when it can truncate.
A glyph after the label (12px, 11px at sm), aria-hidden (a failed task's retry arrow).

tone.description: neutral (inset fill, ink-2 text), the four status tones with their tint pairs (accent: accent-tint and accent-ink; green, orange, red), and blue, whose fill and text mix from color.tag-blue (a beta badge, for instance).

mark.description: Render the mark (circle with a check) in place of the dot; it pops in when it appears after the first paint (a status change).

dotTone.description: A neutral pill whose dot alone takes this colour: the status tones or one of the tag hues (a diff-table category). Set only when given.

slots.trailingIcon: A glyph after the label (React: trailingIcon node; Vue: #trailing slot; Svelte: trailingIcon snippet).

notes: The dot and the mark are aria-hidden; the label carries the state. Tone alone never does.
When the status changes while the user waits, put the pill in a role="status" region.

motion: the mark pops in when it appears after the pill has been painted (a status change): opacity and scale from motion.popup-scale, duration.popup, easing.out-strong, from @starting-style; data-enter marks a painted pill (lib/paint.ts), so nothing plays on first paint and setting data-enter starts nothing; reduced motion: fade only
